## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Playwright flow
- [ ] Desktop and mobile viewport checked

## VR360 checklist

- [ ] Viewer is destroyed when the scene changes or unmounts
- [ ] New panorama is local or properly licensed
- [ ] Attribution is present where required
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion behavior remains usable
- [ ] No secret or real administrator credential is included
